title: PolyOdds Top Signals Snapshot — x402-enabled sports signal intelligence for auto
description: PolyOdds Top Signals Snapshot — x402-enabled sports signal intelligence for autonomous agents. Returns up to 3 ranked prediction-market sports signals. Execution is external on Polymarket, Kalshi, or operator workflow.

bazaar.description:
PolyOdds — Structured sports trading signal. Built for agents.
Pay-per-call x402 endpoint returning real-time prediction-market sports signals across Polymarket and Kalshi. Each call returns up to 3 ranked signals with venue, outcome, edge %, fair probability, liquidity context, and external execution URL. Signal intelligence only — no guaranteed profit, no direct venue execution.

Endpoint: GET https://polyodds.bet/api/x402/resources/top-signals
Price: $0.50 USDC per call
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453)
Asset: USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
Discovery manifest: https://polyodds.bet/api/x402/manifest
Quickstart: https://polyodds.bet/v1/agent/quickstart
Tags: sports · prediction-markets · polymarket · kalshi · signals · x402 · agents
